What is the official website to verify SBI recruitment updates?

The official website for all genuine SBI notifications and recruitment updates is sbi.co.in. Candidates should rely exclusively on this domain.

Is there a minimum sectional cutoff score in SBI Junior Associate Phase I?

No, as per standard SBI guidelines, there are no minimum individual sectional cutoffs in the Preliminary Examination. Shortlisting is based purely on total aggregate marks.

Is there negative marking in the Phase I preliminary examination?

Yes, a penalty of one-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for every incorrect response in the objective test.

What educational qualifications are required to apply?

Candidates must hold a valid Graduation degree in any discipline from a recognized University or equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government.

How can candidates download the official Phase I Information Handout?

Candidates can visit sbi.co.in, navigate to the Careers section under Latest Announcements, and download the official PDF notice directly.

To qualify for the SBI Junior Associate recruitment process, candidates must fulfill essential academic and language criteria set by the bank.   • Scheduled Caste (SC) / Scheduled Tribe (ST): Relaxation of up to 5 years above the upper age limit.

The recruitment process for SBI Junior Associates is structured into two online written stages: Phase I Preliminary Examination and Phase II Main Examination. The Phase I Preliminary Exam serves as an initial screening test and consists of objective-type questions administered online across three core sections.

  • English Language: 30 Questions | 30 Marks | Duration: 20 Minutes
  • Numerical Ability: 35 Questions | 35 Marks | Duration: 20 Minutes
  • Reasoning Ability: 35 Questions | 35 Marks | Duration: 20 Minutes

The overall Preliminary exam comprises 100 questions carrying 100 total marks with an aggregate time limit of 1 hour (60 minutes). Each section features a strict individual time limit of 20 minutes, automatically moving candidates to the next section once time expires. A penalty of one-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for every incorrect answer. Candidates must maintain high accuracy to clear normalized score thresholds.

Step-by-Step Online Application & Document Upload Guide

Candidates must submit their applications exclusively online through the official State Bank of India portal. Applicants are advised to keep scanned copies of all required documents, including photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration, ready prior to starting registration.

  1. Visit the official website of State Bank of India at sbi.co.in and navigate to the 'Careers' tab.
  2. Locate the latest notification for Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) recruitment and click on 'Apply Online'.
  3. Complete the initial registration process by entering your basic personal details, mobile number, and active email address to generate a Registration ID and Password.
  4. Log in with your credentials and fill out academic details, category selection, and state preferences accurately.
  5. Upload scanned images of your passport photo, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration adhering to the prescribed file size and dimension specifications.
  6. Review the preview application form carefully to verify all entered data before final submission.
  7. Proceed to the online payment gateway to pay the required category-wise application fee using net banking, debit cards, or UPI.
  8. Download and print out the completed application form and fee payment receipt for future reference.

Selection Stages & Final Merit List Formulation

The selection architecture comprises three sequential evaluations designed to test speed, subject knowledge, and local language proficiency. Candidates who clear the Phase I Preliminary online test are shortlisted for the Phase II Main examination in a ratio established by the bank. Marks obtained in the Preliminary examination are qualifying in nature and are not added to the final merit ranking.

The Phase II Main Examination evaluates Advanced Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, General/Financial Awareness, and General English. Final merit lists are prepared state-wise and category-wise based strictly on aggregate marks scored in the Main Examination. Selected candidates must subsequently qualify in the Specified Opted Local Language Test (unless they have studied the language in 10th or 12th standard) and complete Document Verification (DV) alongside pre-employment medical fitness checks.

Key Preparation Strategy & Exam Day Guidelines

Given the intense competition for banking positions, candidates should follow a disciplined study framework focused on sectional speed and conceptual clarity. For Numerical Ability and Reasoning, daily practice of mock tests under timed conditions helps build speed and accuracy. Reviewing fundamental concepts in arithmetic, data interpretation, and analytical logic is vital for tackling preliminary questions efficiently.

On examination day, candidates must report to their assigned exam center well ahead of the reporting time printed on their admit card. Required identity verification items include a clear printout of the Call Letter with a passport-size photo pasted on it, an original valid photo ID proof (such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, or Voter ID), and a clear photocopy of the same ID proof. Failure to produce original identity documents will result in disqualification at the entry gate.

What is the official website to check SBI recruitment updates?

The official domain for all State Bank of India recruitment notices and updates is sbi.co.in. Applicants should regularly check the 'Careers' section on sbi.co.in for authentic announcements.

Is there negative marking in the SBI Junior Associate Preliminary examination?

Yes, there is a negative marking penalty of 1/4th (0.25) of the total marks assigned to a question for every incorrect answer in the objective tests.

Can final-year college students apply for the SBI Junior Associate post?

Final-year students can apply provisionally, provided they can produce proof of passing the graduation examination on or before the cut-off date specified in the official notification.

Are marks from the Preliminary exam counted in the final selection merit list?

No, the preliminary examination is strictly qualifying in nature. The final merit list is prepared based solely on the aggregate marks obtained in the Phase II Main Examination.

articles.content_html:
The State Bank of India released its official scribe guidelines on September 15, 2026, establishing operational protocols for candidates with benchmark disabilities participating in national recruitment examinations. Visually impaired candidates and individuals with physical limitations affecting writing speed must comply with these detailed rules to ensure fair examination conditions. Aspirants can access and download the notification directly from the bank's official portal at sbi.co.in.

Key Highlights & Important Dates

Event / Activity Official Date / Status
Notification ReleasedSeptember 15, 2026
Official Portalsbi.co.in

Overview & Background of State Bank of India Notification

The State Bank of India (SBI) regularly conducts competitive examinations across India to recruit officers, clerical cadre, and specialized personnel. To promote equal opportunity and accessibility, the bank aligns its recruitment practices with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (PwBD) regulations. The newly released guidelines outline standard operating procedures for candidates who require the assistance of a scribe or extra time during online computer-based tests.

Released on September 15, 2026, the updated instructions apply to upcoming recruitment cycles, including the Junior Associate and officer cadre selections. Candidates with benchmark disabilities such as visual impairment, cerebral palsy, or locomotor disability where writing speed is affected must familiarize themselves with these guidelines. Adherence to these protocols ensures that all eligible candidates receive proper accommodations without compromising administrative integrity.

Eligibility Criteria & Minimum Educational Qualifications

To participate in SBI recruitment drives, applicants must fulfill standard educational and physical benchmarks specified in individual recruitment notifications. Generally, clerical and officer roles require a recognized bachelor's degree in any discipline from a university recognized by the Government of India or equivalent qualifications approved by central authorities.

Candidates seeking scribe assistance must meet specific disability thresholds. As per standard guidelines, candidates with benchmark disabilities of 40% or more who have physical limitations in writing are eligible to use scribe services. The scribe engaged by the candidate must satisfy key conditions:

  • The scribe should not be a candidate for the same online examination.
  • The scribe can belong to any academic stream, but their educational qualification should ideally be one step below the minimum qualification required for the post, or meet specific academic limits set by the bank.
  • Both the candidate and the scribe must submit an official joint declaration undertaking with recent passport-size photographs before taking the examination.

Age Limit Criteria & Category-Wise Relaxations

Age requirements for SBI recruitment typically range between 20 to 28 years for clerical positions, with higher upper age limits for officer-level entries. The calculation of the candidate's age relies on the official cut-off date stated in the specific job advertisement.

Candidates belonging to reserved categories and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) receive statutory age relaxations in accordance with central government rules. The typical upper age relaxations are structured as follows:

CategoryStandard Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe (SC/ST)5 Years
Other Backward Classes (OBC - Non-Creamy Layer)3 Years
PwBD (General / EWS)10 Years
PwBD (OBC)13 Years
PwBD (SC / ST)15 Years
Ex-Servicemen / Disabled Ex-ServicemenActual period of service rendered + 3 years (subject to maximum limits)

Pay Scale, Salary Structure & 7th CPC Allowances

Candidates selected through SBI recruitment processes enjoy structured compensation packages aligned with industry standards and bipartite settlements. For Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales), the basic pay structure begins at an entry-level scale with fixed incremental stages, accompanied by applicable allowances in public sector banking.

Total emoluments include basic pay, Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Special Allowance, and Transport Allowance. In major metro cities, the starting gross salary for clerical positions offers stability alongside additional benefits such as medical reimbursement, defined pension scheme coverage, and concessionary credit facilities. Career progression through internal fast-track promotion examinations enables employees to advance to officer cadres within specified timeframes.

Comprehensive Examination Pattern & Syllabus Structure

SBI selection processes generally consist of a multi-phase online examination system designed to test aptitude, language proficiency, and core analytical abilities.

  • Phase I: Preliminary Examination (Objective) — A 100-mark screening test lasting 60 minutes, split into three sectional timings: English Language (30 Questions / 30 Marks), Quantitative Aptitude (35 Questions / 35 Marks), and Reasoning Ability (35 Questions / 35 Marks).
  • Phase II: Main Examination (Objective & Descriptive) — A comprehensive 200-mark evaluation covering General/Financial Awareness, General English, Quantitative Aptitude, and Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude over a duration of 2 hours and 40 minutes.

Negative marking applies to objective tests, where one-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question are deducted for every incorrect answer. Candidates eligible for scribe facilities receive compensatory time at the rate of 20 minutes per hour of the examination duration, regardless of whether a scribe is used, provided the candidate meets the eligibility criteria for extra time.

Step-by-Step Online Application & Document Upload Guide

Candidates requiring scribe assistance must register their preference accurately during the online application process. The step-by-step procedure includes the following stages:

  1. Visit the official State Bank of India careers portal at sbi.co.in/careers.
  2. Access the relevant recruitment advertisement and click on 'Apply Online' to start the application form.
  3. Fill in personal credentials, educational details, and select 'Yes' under the PwBD category status and scribe requirement options.
  4. Upload scanned images of a recent passport photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and a handwritten declaration as per specification guidelines.
  5. Download the Scribe Declaration Form available on the portal, complete all details, and attach photographs of both the candidate and the scribe.
  6. Pay the applicable application fee via online banking channels and retain a printout of the final submitted application form for administrative verification.

Selection Stages & Final Merit List Formulation

The recruitment workflow relies strictly on merit across multiple stages. Marks obtained in the Phase I Preliminary examination serve solely for shortlisting candidates for the Phase II Main examination and are not added to the final ranking.

The final merit list is compiled based on the total marks scored in the Phase II Main Examination (and local language proficiency tests where applicable). Normalized scoring techniques adjust for slight variations across different test shifts. Candidates qualifying in the merit list proceed to document verification (DV) and biometric authentication, followed by pre-employment medical checks.

Key Preparation Strategy & Exam Day Guidelines

Candidates utilizing a scribe should practice test series alongside their scribe prior to exam day. This ensures effective coordination, clear communication, and familiarization with online test navigation controls.

On the examination day, candidate and scribe must arrive at the test center well in advance with essential documents: call letter, valid original photo identity card, a copy of the scribe's photo ID, and the fully completed, signed Scribe Declaration Form. Failure to present the required scribe documentation at the center will prevent the candidate from taking the examination.

  2. On the homepage, navigate to the 'Latest Notices' or 'Examination/Recruitment' section.
  3. Locate and select the link for 'SCRIBE GUIDELINES'.
  4. Download and carefully review the official notice for verified instructions.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the official website to verify State Bank of India updates?

Candidates must verify all official notices and downloads on the official State Bank of India portal at sbi.co.in.

How much compensatory time is allowed for PwBD candidates in SBI exams?

Eligible PwBD candidates using a scribe or opting for extra time receive compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of exam duration.

Can a candidate choose anyone as their scribe?

The scribe should meet SBI's eligibility rules, must not be an applicant for the same exam, and must submit a joint declaration form with the candidate.

Where can candidates download the official SBI Scribe Guidelines PDF?

The official PDF document can be downloaded directly from the SBI careers section at sbi.co.in.

What documents must the scribe carry to the examination hall?

The scribe must carry a valid photo ID card in original, a self-attested photocopy of the ID card, and the completed joint Scribe Declaration Form with photographs.

Is negative marking applicable to candidates using a scribe?

Yes, standard negative marking rules (0.25 marks deducted per wrong answer) apply uniformly to all candidates across objective tests.

articles.content_html:
State Bank of India (SBI) officially published the recruitment advertisement for Junior Associate positions on September 15, 2026. Candidates across India seeking a career in public sector banking can access the detailed notice directly on the official portal, sbi.co.in. This detailed guide covers eligibility standards, examination patterns, salary structures, and step-by-step application instructions to help applicants complete their registration accurately.

Key Highlights & Important Dates

Event / Activity Official Date / Status
Notification ReleasedSeptember 15, 2026
Official Portalsbi.co.in

Overview & Background of State Bank of India Notification

State Bank of India is the nation's largest public sector banking institution, offering comprehensive career opportunities for civil service and banking aspirants nationwide. On September 15, 2026, SBI published the official notification for the Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) recruitment drive. Candidates interested in securing a position in the clerical cadre must review the official recruitment document available on the bank's career section.

Recruitment into the Junior Associate cadre serves as a gateway to financial security and professional growth within India's premier financial institution. Candidates selected through this drive are posted across various branches nationwide, handling customer relations, financial transactions, and operational banking tasks. Applicants are strongly advised to download the official PDF notification directly from sbi.co.in to verify state-wise vacancy distribution and specific guidelines.

Eligibility Criteria & Minimum Educational Qualifications

To qualify for the State Bank of India Junior Associate recruitment, applicants must meet the basic academic and demographic requirements established by the bank. The fundamental educational qualification is a graduation degree in any discipline from a recognized university or any equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government. Candidates holding integrated dual degrees must ensure their qualifying graduation date falls within the prescribed timeline indicated in the official notice.

Final-year undergraduate students may also apply on a provisional basis, provided they can produce proof of having passed the graduation examination on or before the cut-off date specified in the detailed notification. In addition to academic qualification, candidates must possess proficiency in the specified local language of the state or union territory they choose to apply for. Local language proficiency involves the ability to read, write, speak, and understand the official language of the selected region fluently.

Age Limit Criteria & Category-Wise Relaxations

The standard age limit for candidates applying to the clerical cadre ranges between 20 years and 28 years as of the cut-off date specified in the official notification. Candidates must have been born within the date range prescribed in the official rules to be eligible for general unreserved seats.

Government regulations provide upper age relaxations for candidates belonging to reserved categories. The permissible age relaxations are outlined below:

  • Other Backward Classes (OBC - Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years relaxation above the upper age limit.
  • Scheduled Castes (SC) & Scheduled Tribes (ST): 5 years relaxation above the upper age limit.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 10 years for General/EWS, 13 years for OBC, and 15 years for SC/ST candidates.
  • Ex-Servicemen (ESM): Relaxation equal to the period of military service rendered plus 3 years, up to a maximum upper age limit of 50 years.

Pay Scale, Salary Structure & 7th CPC Allowances

State Bank of India offers an attractive compensation package for Junior Associates. The pay structure is governed by Bipartite Settlements applicable to public sector bank employees. The revised basic pay scale for clerical staff starts at a competitive base pay, accompanied by multiple allowances that significantly enhance total monthly earnings.

In addition to basic pay, selected candidates are entitled to several allowances and perquisites, including:

  • Dearness Allowance (DA): Revised quarterly based on the Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers.
  • House Rent Allowance (HRA): Variable rates based on the classification of the posting city (Metropolitan, Urban, Semi-Urban, or Rural).
  • Transport & Special Allowances: Monthly fixed compensation to cover commuting and functional responsibilities.
  • Medical & Pension Benefits: Coverage under the Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS), medical reimbursement for self and dependents, and annual leave concessions.

Junior Associates enjoy clear career progression pathways, becoming eligible for promotion to Officer Grade (TO/JMGS-I) after completing the mandatory service period and clearing internal promotional examinations.

Comprehensive Examination Pattern & Syllabus Structure

The selection process for SBI Junior Associates consists of a two-phase online objective examination: Phase I (Preliminary Examination) and Phase II (Main Examination). Both examinations are conducted online across various centers nationwide.

Phase I: Preliminary Examination Pattern
The preliminary examination is a qualifying screening test consisting of 100 objective questions totaling 100 marks, with a total duration of 60 minutes. Each section is assigned a separate sectional timing of 20 minutes.

  • English Language: 30 Questions | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
  • Quantitative Aptitude: 35 Questions | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
  • Reasoning Ability: 35 Questions | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes

Phase II: Main Examination Pattern
Candidates who clear the preliminary round are shortlisted for the Main Examination. The Mains paper comprises 190 questions totaling 200 marks, with a total allotted time of 2 hours and 40 minutes. The paper covers four major sections: General/Financial Awareness, General English, Quantitative Aptitude, and Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude.

Negative Marking Rule: For both Preliminary and Main examinations, a penalty of 1/4th (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for every incorrect answer. No marks are deducted for unattempted questions.

Step-by-Step Online Application & Document Upload Guide

Candidates must submit their applications exclusively online through the bank's portal. Applicants should keep scanned copies of their photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration ready before initiating registration.

  1. Access Official Portal: Visit the official website at sbi.co.in and navigate to the "Careers" section.
  2. New Registration: Click on the recruitment notice link titled 'English) (714 KB)' or the relevant JA recruitment link and select "Click Here for New Registration". Enter basic contact details including full name, mobile number, and email ID to generate a Registration Number and Password.
  3. Application Form Filling: Log in using credentials to complete personal details, educational qualifications, category choices, and examination center preferences.
  4. Document Upload: Upload scanned images of your recent passport-size photograph, signature on white paper with black ink, left thumb impression, and mandatory handwritten declaration adhering to prescribed file size and dimensions.
  5. Application Fee Payment: Pay the required application fee online using net banking, debit cards, credit cards, or UPI. Candidates should check the official PDF notification for category-wise fee details.
  6. Final Preview & Printout: Review all entered data carefully prior to final submission. Download and print the completed application form and payment receipt for future reference.

Selection Stages & Final Merit List Formulation

The recruitment process strictly follows a merit-based evaluation framework across distinct operational phases. The preliminary examination serves purely as a screening test to filter candidates for the Main examination; marks obtained in Phase I are not counted toward the final merit list.

The final selection list is prepared based solely on performance in the Phase II Main Examination. Marks obtained in the Mains paper are normalized across multiple shifts using standard statistical methods to maintain equity. Shortlisted candidates must subsequently pass the Specified Local Language Test (unless they studied the local language in 10th or 12th standard) and complete Document Verification (DV) along with a mandatory medical fitness assessment before receiving final appointment letters.

Key Preparation Strategy & Exam Day Guidelines

Securing a high score in competitive banking examinations demands systematic preparation and strategic time management. Candidates should focus on building foundational clarity in Quantitative Aptitude and Reasoning Ability while maintaining daily practice of online mock tests to improve speed and accuracy.

Key preparation strategies include:

  • Consistent Current Affairs Revision: Stay updated with national economy news, banking terms, RBI circulars, and financial developments over the last six months.
  • Mock Test Analysis: Solve regular online prelims and mains mock tests. Analyze error patterns to reduce negative marking.
  • Sectional Time Management: Practice answering questions within fixed section limits to build pacing during the exam.

On the day of the examination, candidates must report to the designated venue well before the reporting time printed on the Admit Card. Essential items to carry include a printed copy of the Admit Card, original valid photo identity proof (e.g., Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport), a photocopy of the identity proof, and additional passport-size photographs as instructed.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Go to the official website of State Bank of India at sbi.co.in.
  2. On the homepage, navigate to the 'Latest Notices' or 'Examination/Recruitment' section.
  3. Locate and select the link for 'English) (714 KB)'.
  4. Download and carefully review the official notice for verified instructions.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the official website to verify this State Bank of India update?

The official portal is sbi.co.in. Candidates should rely strictly on official notifications published on the sbi.co.in/careers website.

Where can I download the official SBI recruitment notification PDF?

The direct PDF document can be downloaded directly from the SBI careers web section at sbi.co.in.

What is the educational qualification required for SBI Junior Associate positions?

Candidates must hold a graduation degree in any discipline from a recognized university or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government.

Is there negative marking in the SBI Junior Associate exam?

Yes, there is a penalty of 0.25 marks (1/4th of the total marks assigned to the question) for each incorrect answer in both Preliminary and Main examinations.

Are final year college students eligible to apply?

Yes, final year undergraduate students can apply provisionally, provided they can produce proof of passing the degree examination on or before the cut-off date specified in the official notification.

What is the upper age limit relaxation for OBC and SC/ST candidates?

As per standard government guidelines, upper age limit relaxation is 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates and 5 years for SC/ST candidates.

articles.content_html:
State Bank of India officially announced the detailed recruitment advertisement for Junior Associate 2026 backlog positions on September 15, 2026. The release of this comprehensive notice provides critical clarity for civil service and banking job aspirants seeking entry into India's largest public sector bank. Eligible candidates are advised to inspect the official advertisement uploaded on sbi.co.in to ensure full compliance with updated application standards.

Key Highlights & Important Dates

Event / Activity Official Date / Status
Notification ReleasedSeptember 15, 2026
Official Portalsbi.co.in

Overview & Background of State Bank of India Notification

The State Bank of India (SBI) occupies a central position in the Indian banking system, consistently offering highly sought-after career opportunities through structured recruitment drives. The latest notification issued for Junior Associate 2026 backlog posts marks an important opening for candidates aiming to secure a clerical cadre position in customer support and sales functions across various administrative circles.

Published officially on September 15, 2026, the notice contains detailed operational guidelines, language specifications, and regional distribution details. Candidates must note that backlog recruitment specifically addresses unfilled reserved vacancies from previous selection cycles, ensuring equitable representation across specified categories. Interested applicants should consult the official document available on the bank's career portal at sbi.co.in before commencing their registration process.

Eligibility Criteria & Minimum Educational Qualifications

Educational qualification forms the foundational requirement for candidates applying for the SBI Junior Associate position. Applicants must hold a graduation degree in any discipline from a recognized university or possess an equivalent qualification acknowledged as such by the Central Government. Those possessing integrated dual degrees or professional qualifications like CA or ICWA are also eligible, provided their qualification meets recognized university standards.

In addition to basic academic qualifications, local language proficiency is a essential requirement. Applicants must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking, and understanding the specified local language of the particular state or Union Territory for which they are applying. Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheets or certificates demonstrating that they studied the specified local language are generally exempt from taking a separate language test during final verification.

Age Limit Criteria & Category-Wise Relaxations

Candidates must fall within the prescribed age bracket specified in the official notification as of the cut-off date mentioned by the bank. Standard age requirements for clerical entry generally require candidates to be at least 20 years old and not exceeding 28 years of age. Age calculation strictly adheres to official birth record certificates such as Class 10 matriculation certificates or birth registration documents.

Upper age relaxations are granted to candidates belonging to reserved categories in line with Central Government norms:

  • Scheduled Castes (SC) / Scheduled Tribes (ST): 5 years relaxation.
  • Other Backward Classes (OBC - Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years relaxation.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwD): 10 years for General/EWS, 13 years for OBC, and 15 years for SC/ST candidates.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Period of military service rendered plus 3 years, subject to a maximum age limit prescribed in government guidelines.

Pay Scale, Salary Structure & 7th CPC Allowances

Recruited Junior Associates in the State Bank of India receive a structured compensation package operating under the bipartite settlements and aligned with public sector banking pay levels. The starting basic pay for Junior Associates is set with advance increments granted to graduate entrants, establishing a stable financial starting point for selected candidates.

In addition to the basic pay, SBI employees are entitled to various allowances dependent on the place of posting. These allowances significantly increase the total gross remuneration:

ComponentDescription / Coverage
Dearness Allowance (DA)Revised quarterly based on Consumer Price Index (CPI) numbers.
House Rent Allowance (HRA)Varies according to the city tier (Class A, B, or C cities).
Special Allowance & Transport AllowanceFixed monthly payouts assisting with daily operational expenses.
Perquisites & BenefitsMedical coverage, concessionary housing loans, furniture allowances, and coverage under the National Pension System (NPS).

Comprehensive Examination Pattern & Syllabus Structure

The selection mechanism for SBI Junior Associates consists of a multi-phase online examination designed to evaluate conceptual clarity, numerical efficiency, logical reasoning, and language aptitude. The online objective test framework is conducted across two main phases: Preliminary and Main Examinations.

Phase I: Preliminary Examination
The Preliminary examination is a screening test comprising 100 objective questions worth 100 marks, with a total duration of 1 hour. It features separate sectional timing of 20 minutes for each of the three sections:

  • English Language: 30 Questions (30 Marks)
  • Numerical Ability: 35 Questions (35 Marks)
  • Reasoning Ability: 35 Questions (35 Marks)

Phase II: Main Examination
Candidates who qualify in the preliminary phase are shortlisted for the Main Examination. This phase consists of 190 questions totaling 200 marks with a duration of 2 hours 40 minutes:

  • General / Financial Awareness: 50 Questions (50 Marks) - 35 Minutes
  • General English: 40 Questions (40 Marks) - 35 Minutes
  • Quantitative Aptitude: 50 Questions (50 Marks) - 45 Minutes
  • Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude: 50 Questions (60 Marks) - 45 Minutes

Negative marking applies to both Preliminary and Main online examinations. For every wrong answer, 1/4th of the marks assigned to that specific question will be deducted as a penalty.

Step-by-Step Online Application & Document Upload Guide

Applying for the SBI Junior Associate backlog recruitment involves an online application submission. Candidates should follow these steps to complete their registration correctly:

  1. Access the official recruitment portal by visiting sbi.co.in/careers.
  2. Locate the notification link for SBI Junior Associate 2026 Backlog advertisement and click on 'Apply Online'.
  3. Complete the initial registration by entering basic personal details, an active email address, and a valid mobile number to receive system-generated registration credentials.
  4. Fill out the comprehensive application form including academic qualifications, category details, and state preferences accurately.
  5. Upload scanned images of your recent passport-sized photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and a handwritten declaration strictly adhering to the file size and resolution parameters specified in the guidelines.
  6. Proceed to the payment gateway to pay the required category-wise application fee using online payment modes such as debit card, credit card, net banking, or UPI.
  7. Submit the form, generate a printout of the completed application, and save the payment receipt for future reference during document verification.

Selection Stages & Final Merit List Formulation

The recruitment journey progresses through systematic evaluation tiers. The Preliminary examination serves purely as an initial screening process; marks obtained in the preliminary phase are not added to the final selection list. Shortlisting for the Main Examination is executed based on aggregate performance in Phase I.

The final merit list is prepared strictly on the basis of marks scored by candidates in the Phase II Main Examination. Candidates who qualify in the Main Examination and rank high enough in the merit list must successfully clear the Local Language Test (where applicable), followed by Document Verification (DV) and a Pre-Recruitment Medical Examination. Satisfactory verification of age, educational qualifications, caste certificates, and character references remains mandatory prior to issuing formal appointment letters.

Key Preparation Strategy & Exam Day Guidelines

Given the competitive nature of SBI exams, systematic preparation remains essential. Applicants should focus heavily on speed and accuracy. Time management strategies must be practiced using sectional mock tests, as strict individual time limits prevent moving between sections during the test.

On the day of the examination, candidates must report to the assigned examination center well before the reporting time printed on their call letters. Essential items to carry to the test center include:

  • Printed copy of the official Examination Call Letter / Admit Card.
  • Original valid photo identification proof (e.g., Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport, or Driving License).
  • Clear photocopy of the same original photo ID proof.
  • Two recent passport-size photographs matching the one uploaded in the application form.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Go to the official website of State Bank of India at sbi.co.in.
  2. On the homepage, navigate to the 'Latest Notices' or 'Examination/Recruitment' section.
  3. Locate and select the link for '(Hindi (592 KB)'.
  4. Download and carefully review the official notice for verified instructions.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the official website to verify this State Bank of India recruitment update?

The official website to verify all SBI recruitment notices and updates is sbi.co.in/careers. Candidates should rely strictly on official portals for authentic information.

When was the SBI Junior Associate 2026 Backlog notification released?

The official detailed notification was published on September 15, 2026, on the official State Bank of India portal.

Is there an interview round for SBI Junior Associate recruitment?

No, there is no interview round for clerical cadre (Junior Associate) positions in State Bank of India. Selection is based on performance in the Main Examination, followed by language proficiency testing and document verification.

Is there negative marking in the SBI Junior Associate exam?

Yes, a penalty of 1/4th (0.25) of the total marks allotted to a question is deducted for every incorrect response in both Preliminary and Main objective examinations.

Are final year college students eligible to apply for SBI Junior Associate positions?

Final year students can typically apply provisionally, provided they can produce proof of passing the graduation examination on or before the specific cut-off date defined in the official advertisement.

What is the age limit for general category candidates applying for SBI Junior Associate?

The standard age criteria for general category applicants is generally between 20 to 28 years as of the cut-off date specified in the official notification, with applicable upper age relaxations for reserved categories.

articles.content_html:
The State Bank of India officially released the detailed notification for the Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) recruitment examination on September 15, 2026. Aspirants across the country seeking a career in the public banking sector can access the detailed English advertisement document directly through the official career portal at sbi.co.in. This detailed guide provides a thorough overview of the eligibility requirements, age relaxations, selection methodology, examination pattern, and online registration process.

Key Highlights & Important Dates

Event / Activity Official Date / Status
Notification ReleasedSeptember 15, 2026
Official Portalsbi.co.in

Overview & Background of State Bank of India Notification

The State Bank of India (SBI) is India's largest public sector financial institution, operating a vast network of branches nationwide. The release of the official notification on September 15, 2026, marks the commencement of the recruitment drive for Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales) in the clerical cadre for the 2026 session. Candidates can download the official document, titled 'JA_2026_Detailed_Advt_Eng.pdf', directly from the official bank website at sbi.co.in.

Junior Associates form the core operational backbone of SBI branches. Primary duties include handling customer queries, managing deposit and withdrawal transactions, assisting with account operations, and cross-selling basic banking products. Candidates selected through this competitive process receive stable career progression, competitive pay structures, and opportunity for merit-based promotions to officer cadres within the organization.

Eligibility Criteria & Minimum Educational Qualifications

Candidates aiming to apply for the SBI Junior Associate post must fulfill specific educational qualifications and language requirements specified in the official notification notice:

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must hold a Graduation degree in any discipline from a recognized University or any equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government.
  • Final Year Students: Candidates in the final year or semester of their graduation may also apply provisionally, provided they produce proof of having passed the graduation examination on or before the cut-off date specified in the official advertisement notice.
  • Local Language Proficiency: Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking, and understanding the specified opted local language of the State/UT for which they apply. Proficiency is assessed through standard educational mark sheets or a dedicated local language test prior to final joining.

Age Limit Criteria & Category-Wise Relaxations

The standard age limit prescribed for candidates applying for the SBI Junior Associate examination generally ranges between 20 years and 28 years as of the cut-off date specified in the official notification. Candidates must ensure they fulfill the age criteria before initiating their application.

Upper age relaxations are granted to candidates belonging to reserved categories in accordance with Government of India directives. The standard relaxation structure is outlined below:

CategoryUpper Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe (SC/ST)5 Years
Other Backward Classes (OBC - Non-Creamy Layer)3 Years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD - Gen/EWS)10 Years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD - SC/ST)15 Years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD - OBC)13 Years
Ex-Servicemen / Disabled Ex-ServicemenActual service rendered in defense forces + 3 years (subject to maximum age limit rules)

Pay Scale, Salary Structure & 7th CPC Allowances

SBI offers a competitive pay scale for Junior Associates in the clerical cadre. The basic pay structure begins at ₹17,900 with advance increments allowed for graduate entrants, progressing through structured pay bands as per industry agreements.

In addition to basic pay, selected candidates receive various allowances, benefits, and statutory perks standard to public sector banking posts:

  • Dearness Allowance (DA): Revised quarterly based on the Consumer Price Index (CPI).
  • House Rent Allowance (HRA): Calculated based on the place of posting (Metro, Urban, Semi-Urban, or Rural areas).
  • Special Allowance & Transport Allowance: Standard monthly allowances as per clerical cadre rules.
  • Perks & Facilities: Medical insurance facilities, housing loan benefits at concessional interest rates, pension coverage under the National Pension System (NPS), and leave travel concessions.

Comprehensive Examination Pattern & Syllabus Structure

The selection process for SBI Junior Associates consists of a two-phase online examination system: the Preliminary Examination and the Main Examination, followed by a local language test where applicable.

1. Preliminary Examination (Objective Test)

The Preliminary Exam serves as an initial screening test. It consists of an objective test for 100 marks conducted online, with a total duration of 1 hour divided into separate sectional timings.

Test SectionNo. of QuestionsMaximum MarksDuration
English Language303020 Minutes
Numerical Ability353520 Minutes
Reasoning Ability353520 Minutes
Total10010060 Minutes

Penalty for Wrong Answers: There is a negative marking of 1/4th (0.25) of the mark assigned to a question for every incorrect answer.

2. Main Examination (Objective Test)

Candidates who qualify in the Preliminary round are shortlisted for the Main Examination. The Main Exam tests deeper domain knowledge, analytical capabilities, and financial awareness.

Test SectionNo. of QuestionsMaximum MarksDuration
General / Financial Awareness505035 Minutes
General English404035 Minutes
Quantitative Aptitude505045 Minutes
Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude506045 Minutes
Total190200160 Minutes

Step-by-Step Online Application & Document Upload Guide

Applicants must submit their registration forms exclusively online through the official portal. Below is the step-by-step procedure to complete the submission successfully:

  1. Access Official Portal: Visit the official website of State Bank of India at sbi.co.in and navigate to the 'Careers' section under 'Latest Recruitment Notices'.
  2. Read Notification: Locate the advertisement link titled 'English) (959 KB)' or PDF file JA_2026_Detailed_Advt_Eng.pdf and download it to review all detailed instructions.
  3. New Candidate Registration: Click on 'Apply Online'. Select 'New Registration' and enter basic details such as full name, mobile number, and valid email address.
  4. Note Credentials: System-generated registration number and password will be displayed on-screen and sent via SMS/email.
  5. Document Upload: Upload clear scanned copies of required documents including candidate's recent passport photograph, signature (in black ink), left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as specified in the guidelines.
  6. Fill Details: Complete educational qualifications, personal details, category choices, and preferred circle/state of posting.
  7. Fee Payment: Pay the required application fee online using net banking, credit cards, debit cards, or UPI channels. Category-wise fee details are specified in the official PDF notice.
  8. Final Printout: Download and print a copy of the filled application form and fee payment receipt for future reference.

Selection Stages & Final Merit List Formulation

The final selection list is prepared strictly based on merit derived from candidate performance across the designated phases:

  • Prelims Shortlisting: Marks obtained in the Preliminary Examination are used only for shortlisting candidates for the Main Examination and are not added to the final merit list.
  • Mains Aggregate Score: The marks obtained in the Main Examination determine the aggregate ranking of candidates within their respective state and category.
  • Specified Opted Local Language Test: Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheets showing study of the specified local language are exempt. Others must clear the local language test before final appointment. Unqualified candidates at this stage are disqualified.
  • Document & Medical Verification: Provisionally selected candidates must undergo document verification (checking original identity, educational degree certificates, category certificates) and satisfy medical fitness standards set by the bank.

Key Preparation Strategy & Exam Day Guidelines

Clearing the SBI Junior Associate exam requires systematic preparation focusing on speed, accuracy, and clear conceptual understanding across all sections.

  • Sectional Time Management: Practice sectional mock tests within 20-minute windows to adapt to the strict online examination environment.
  • General & Financial Awareness: Maintain regular notes on current affairs, banking terms, RBI policies, financial sector updates, and static general knowledge covering the preceding 5 to 6 months.
  • Syllabus Focus: Focus heavily on Data Interpretation, Simplification, Number Series, Puzzles, Seating Arrangements, and Reading Comprehension.
  • Exam Day Documents: Candidates must bring a printed copy of the Admit Card (Call Letter), recent passport photos matching the application, and an original valid photo identity proof (along with one photocopy) to the exam hall.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Go to the official website of State Bank of India at sbi.co.in.
  2. On the homepage, navigate to the 'Latest Notices' or 'Examination/Recruitment' section.
  3. Locate and select the link for 'English) (959 KB)'.
  4. Download and carefully review the official notice for verified instructions.

Verified Direct Links

Resource / Document Direct Official Link
Official Notification PDFClick Here ↗
Official Website (sbi.co.in)Visit Official Portal ↗

  • • SBI CTC Negotiation Form 2026 Released: Official PDF Download & Instructions
  • • SBI CTC Negotiation Format 2026 Out: Download Document and Selection Details

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the official portal to check the SBI Junior Associate 2026 notification?

Candidates must verify all details and notifications directly through the official State Bank of India portal at sbi.co.in.

Where can candidates download the detailed SBI JA 2026 English PDF notification?

The detailed English advertisement notice (JA_2026_Detailed_Advt_Eng.pdf) can be downloaded directly from the official link provided on sbi.co.in.

Are final year graduation students eligible to apply for SBI Junior Associate?

Yes, final year or final semester students can generally apply provisionally, provided they produce proof of having passed the graduation exam on or before the cut-off date specified in the official notification.

Is there negative marking in the SBI Junior Associate online exam?

Yes, there is a penalty for wrong answers. A deduction of 1/4th (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question is made for every incorrect response in both Preliminary and Main objective examinations.

Are Preliminary Exam marks counted for the final SBI JA merit list?

No, marks obtained in the Preliminary Examination are used solely for shortlisting candidates for the Main Examination and are not added to the final selection merit list.

What is the upper age relaxation for OBC and SC/ST candidates?

Upper age relaxation is 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates and 5 years for SC/ST candidates over the prescribed maximum age limit.

Overview & Background of State Bank of India Notification

The State Bank of India (SBI), the country's largest public sector banking institution, routinely conducts recruitment drives across various cadres including Specialist Cadre Officers (SCO), Probationary Officers (PO), and Junior Associates. To ensure transparency, procedural accuracy, and strict legal compliance during candidate selection, SBI mandates the submission of specific undertaking declarations. On September 15, 2026, the bank updated its careers portal at sbi.co.in with the official Undertaking Format under document reference SCO_15.

Submitting a correctly filled undertaking prevents administrative delays and ensures that candidate files move smoothly through the Central Recruitment & Promotion Department (CRPD) verification pipeline.

Eligibility conditions for recruitment under State Bank of India Specialist Cadre Officer profiles are strictly governed by specific post notifications published on the official web portal. Candidates applying for technology, finance, legal, or administrative roles must hold degrees from recognized universities or institutes approved by the UGC, AICTE, or relevant statutory bodies.

  • General Eligibility Verification: Applicants must ensure all qualifying degree mark sheets, provisional certificates, and experience records are fully valid prior to completing the official undertaking form.

State Bank of India has issued an official recruitment notice on its primary career portal for candidates seeking career opportunities in public sector banking. Overview & Background of State Bank of India Notification

State Bank of India stands as the country's largest public sector banking institution, routinely conducting competitive recruitments to fill specialized, technical, and managerial positions nationwide. On September 15, 2026, the bank updated its official career gateway with a fresh recruitment advertisement document titled 'English (941 KB)' under Advertisement Number Final Advt TFO IBG SCO 15. This notification caters to central and nationwide recruitment openings across specialized banking divisions.

Aspirants eyeing a stable administrative or specialized officer career in the public banking sector must carefully review the officially published guidelines. The public notice contains essential information regarding operational posts, eligibility framework, application steps, and document submission protocols. Securing precise details from the official channel helps candidates prepare accurate applications without relying on third-party rumors.

Eligibility Criteria & Minimum Educational Qualifications

Eligibility criteria for State Bank of India recruitments depend strictly on the specific cadre and post tier announced in the detailed advertisement. Generally, candidates applying for officer-level roles must hold a recognized Bachelor's degree or higher qualification from a university incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature in India, or an equivalent institution recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC).

For specialized cadres such as Specialist Cadre Officers (SCO) or Trade Finance Officers (TFO), applicants typically require domain-specific professional qualifications. These may include certifications in international banking, trade finance, chartered accountancy, financial analysis, or post-graduate degrees in business administration, finance, or economics. Candidates must also ensure they possess relevant post-qualification professional experience wherever explicitly mandated by official notice guidelines.

Age Limit Criteria & Category-Wise Relaxations

The standard age parameters for SBI officer recruitments are computed based on the cutoff date specified inside the official PDF document. Age thresholds vary according to the pay scale level and responsibility profile of the vacant position. Applicants must verify that their date of birth falls within the strict upper and lower limits defined in the primary notification.

In alignment with Government of India regulations, age relaxations are extended to candidates belonging to reserved categories. Standard category-wise age relaxations are outlined below:

  • Other Backward Classes (OBC - Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years upper age relaxation.
  • Scheduled Castes / Scheduled Tribes (SC/ST): 5 years upper age relaxation.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 10 years for General/EWS, 13 years for OBC, and 15 years for SC/ST candidates.
  • Ex-Servicemen / Commissioned Officers: As per statutory central government directives based on total military service rendered.

Pay Scale, Salary Structure & 7th CPC Allowances

Selected candidates in State Bank of India enjoy competitive pay structures governed by Bipartite Settlements and officer wage revisions across the public banking industry. In addition to basic pay, SBI officers are entitled to a comprehensive suite of allowances and perquisites that make these positions highly sought after.

Key components of the compensation package include Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA) or leased accommodation facility, City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), and Transport Allowance. Furthermore, officers receive extensive medical cover for self and dependents, concessionary loan facilities, leave travel concessions (LTC), pension benefits under the National Pension System (NPS), and structured avenues for internal promotional advancement into executive management grades.

Comprehensive Examination Pattern & Syllabus Structure

Selection for specialized banking roles in SBI generally involves an evaluation mechanism that may consist of an online written assessment, shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview. When a written test is administered, it assesses both general aptitude and specialized domain knowledge.

In objective written examinations, negative marking rules standardly apply, where 0.25 marks are deducted for every incorrect response. Candidates must achieve minimum qualifying cutoffs in individual sections as well as total aggregate scores to qualify for subsequent evaluation rounds.

Candidates must complete their online registration exclusively through the official portal. To submit an application successfully, follow these standard operational steps:

  1. Visit the official portal of State Bank of India at sbi.co.in and select the 'Careers' section.
  2. Navigate to the 'Latest Notices' tab and locate the recruitment notification titled English (941 KB) or advertisement reference SCO 15.
  3. Download and thoroughly read the official notice PDF to verify all personal eligibility parameters.
  4. Click on the 'Apply Online' link to open the candidate registration form.
  5. Enter personal details, educational qualifications, contact information, and professional work experience accurately.
  6. Upload scanned images of your recent passport photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and written declaration in the prescribed file sizes.
  7. Upload supporting PDF documents, including age proof, degree certificates, marksheets, caste certificates, and experience certificates where required.
  8. Pay the applicable application fee using the secure online payment gateway via net banking, debit card, or credit card.
  9. Submit the final application form and save a printed copy of the confirmation page and fee receipt for future reference.

The recruitment process follows a multi-stage evaluation framework designed to select competent professionals. Depending on the post profile, the evaluation stages comprise initial screening of applications, written test or shortlisting, professional interview, and document verification.

The preliminary screening team verifies whether applicants meet the strict criteria specified in the notification. For posts where interviews carry primary weightage, candidates are shortlisted in a predetermined ratio based on their qualifications and experience profile. The final merit list is compiled on the basis of candidate performance in the selection rounds (written test and/or interview), subject to fulfilling medical fitness standards verified during pre-employment medical examinations.

Preparing for SBI specialist examinations requires a focused strategy centered on domain mastery and analytical practice. Candidates should prioritize reviewing core professional concepts relevant to international trade, banking regulations, credit administration, and current financial updates.

On the day of the examination or interview, candidates must bring a clear printout of their call letter alongside a valid original photo identity card (e.g., Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, or Voter ID) along with a clear photocopy. Arriving at the designated examination center well before the reporting time specified on the admit card ensures smooth biometric verification and seating procedures.

Candidates can submit queries through the official candidate helpdesk link available on the sbi.co.in/careers portal or use the contact details provided inside the official notification document.

articles.content_html:
State Bank of India (SBI) has formally released the official CTC Negotiation Form on its recruitment portal, sbi.co.in. This document is a required component for candidates progressing through the final selection stages of specialized, lateral entry, and contractual officer recruitments. Shortlisted applicants must complete and submit this form along with verifiable remuneration records to determine their final compensation package.

Key Highlights & Important Dates

Event / Activity Official Date / Status
Notification ReleasedSeptember 15, 2026
Official Portalsbi.co.in

Overview & Background of State Bank of India Notification

State Bank of India regularly conducts specialized recruitment drives to onboard experienced professionals across various banking verticals, including digital technology, risk management, credit analysis, and wealth management. The publication of the CTC Negotiation Form on September 15, 2026, marks an important milestone for shortlisted candidates preparing for final appointment formalization. This document serves as the official framework for evaluating an applicant's existing compensation package against SBI salary bands.

Unlike general cadre recruitment, contractual and specialist positions require individualized salary evaluation based on current earnings, market benchmarks, and domain expertise. Candidates must access the official document directly from the bank's career website at sbi.co.in. Accessing authorized portals ensures applicants receive official formats and avoid unverified documentation circulating on third-party websites.

Eligibility Criteria & Minimum Educational Qualifications

Eligibility for positions requiring CTC negotiation depends on the specific job notification issued by State Bank of India. Generally, lateral entry and specialist officer posts require candidates to possess relevant professional qualifications from recognized institutions. Educational qualifications typically include a Bachelor's degree, Post Graduate degree, CA, CFA, MBA, or B.Tech/B.E. in relevant disciplines, as mandated by the detailed advertisement for each role.

Degrees must be obtained from universities or institutes recognized by statutory bodies such as UGC or AICTE. In addition to academic credentials, candidates must meet post-qualification work experience criteria. Candidates should verify that their experience certificates, current employer offer letters, and salary structure match the eligibility conditions specified in their initial recruitment notice before completing the negotiation document.

Age Limit Criteria & Category-Wise Relaxations

Age parameters for specialized posts in SBI are established according to official cadre rules published in the recruitment notices. The cutoff date for calculating minimum and maximum age limits is specified in the individual advertisement for each cadre. Applicants must ensure they meet the upper age threshold set for their target post prior to submitting negotiation materials.

Category-wise age relaxations apply strictly in accordance with Central Government norms and bank rules. The standard relaxations granted to reserved category applicants are outlined below:

  • Other Backward Classes (OBC - Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years relaxation in upper age limit.
  • Scheduled Castes (SC) / Scheduled Tribes (ST): 5 years relaxation in upper age limit.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 10 to 15 years relaxation depending on category (General PwBD: 10 years, OBC PwBD: 13 years, SC/ST PwBD: 15 years).
  • Ex-Servicemen (ESM): Relaxation equal to the period of military service rendered plus 3 years, subject to prescribed maximum caps.

Pay Scale, Salary Structure & 7th CPC Allowances

Compensation at State Bank of India for regular cadre officers follows standardized pay scales governed by Bipartite Settlements, whereas specialized contractual positions are structured around negotiate-able Cost to Company (CTC) packages. Regular scale pay includes basic pay, Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), and leased accommodation benefits. Contractual roles, on the other hand, feature a consolidated annual CTC with fixed and variable components.

The CTC Negotiation Form allows the bank's compensation committee to review an applicant's current fixed pay, performance-linked pay, perks, and retiral benefits. Candidates entering these discussions must present precise breakdowns to ensure fair pay alignment. Selected officers also enjoy long-term career progression opportunities, professional development programs, and access to SBI's comprehensive employee welfare initiatives.

Comprehensive Examination Pattern & Syllabus Structure

The selection pipeline for specialist and executive posts in SBI generally combines shortlisting based on educational profile and experience, followed by a written professional knowledge test or direct interview assessment. When an online examination is conducted, the test structure evaluates domain expertise alongside core aptitude sections.

Section / SubjectFocus Areas & Topics CoveredAssessment Type
Professional KnowledgeDomain-specific questions aligned with the specialized job profile (Finance, IT, Credit, Risk, etc.)Objective / Descriptive
Reasoning AbilityAnalytical reasoning, logical puzzles, data sufficiency, and verbal reasoningObjective Test
Quantitative AptitudeData interpretation, arithmetic calculations, probability, and financial mathObjective Test
General / Banking AwarenessCurrent economic developments, banking laws, RBI guidelines, and financial trendsObjective Test

For candidates undergoing direct selection, the personal interview forms the primary basis of selection. Interview panels assess professional competence, leadership capability, and domain knowledge prior to initiating the compensation evaluation stage.

Step-by-Step Online Application & Document Upload Guide

Candidates eligible to submit the CTC Negotiation Form must follow the official protocol outlined on the bank's portal. Accurate completion is mandatory to prevent delays in processing the final appointment letter.

  1. Visit the official website of State Bank of India at sbi.co.in and click on the 'Careers' section.
  2. Navigate to the 'Latest Announcements' tab on the career portal.
  3. Locate the link titled CTC NEGOTIATION FORM under the relevant recruitment notification.
  4. Download the official PDF document using the direct portal link provided in the official repository.
  5. Fill in all required fields accurately, including current basic pay, allowances, expected CTC, and notice period details.
  6. Attach supporting financial proofs, including the last 3 months' salary slips, Form 16, and bank statements showing salary credits.
  7. Submit the completed form along with verified document scans to the designated HR email or online portal specified in your interview call letter.

Selection Stages & Final Merit List Formulation

The final merit list for SBI specialist and lateral recruitments is formulated through a multi-stage screening system. Candidates who clear the preliminary shortlisting or written examination are invited to personal interviews. Marks scored in the interview round determine a candidate's position on the merit list, subject to meeting minimum qualifying benchmarks set by the bank.

Once shortlisted in the interview phase, candidates undergo document verification (DV) where educational certificates, experience letters, and financial documents submitted in the CTC negotiation form are strictly audited. Final appointment offers are subject to clearing the bank's pre-employment medical fitness examination and background verification check.

Key Preparation Strategy & Exam Day Guidelines

Candidates appearing for SBI recruitment assessments and interview rounds must adopt a structured preparation plan. For technical tests, candidates should focus heavily on core professional knowledge subjects and recent regulatory updates in the Indian banking sector. Solving previous year papers and taking mock tests helps improve speed and accuracy under timed conditions.

For the interview and compensation discussion phase, candidates should organize all physical documents in chronological order. Carry original copies of educational mark sheets, degree certificates, experience letters, relieving orders, and current compensation proof. Maintaining professionalism, clear communication, and transparency regarding past earnings ensures a smooth evaluation process during final selection negotiations.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Go to the official website of State Bank of India at sbi.co.in.
  2. On the homepage, navigate to the 'Latest Notices' or 'Examination/Recruitment' section.
  3. Locate and select the link for 'CTC NEGOTIATION FORM'.
  4. Download and carefully review the official notice for verified instructions.

Verified Direct Links

Official Notification PDFClick Here ↗
Official Website (sbi.co.in)Visit Official Portal ↗

  • • SBI CTC Negotiation Format 2026 Out: Download Document and Selection Details
  • • Recruitment Results & Archive

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the official website to verify the SBI CTC Negotiation Form?

The official website to verify and download the form is sbi.co.in. Candidates should only rely on official portal links for genuine updates.

Where can candidates download the official CTC Negotiation Form PDF?

Candidates can download the form directly from the SBI careers section at sbi.co.in using the notification document link provided for the recruitment drive.

Which documents must be submitted along with the CTC Negotiation Form?

Applicants generally need to submit recent salary slips (last 3 months), Form 16 or IT returns, current offer letter, revised pay structure letters, and bank statements reflecting salary credit.

What age relaxation is available for reserved category candidates in SBI recruitment?

Standard age relaxations apply as per government rules: 3 years for OBC (NCL), 5 years for SC/ST, and 10 to 15 years for PwBD candidates depending on their specific sub-category.

How is the final offer decided during CTC negotiation with SBI?

The final remuneration package is determined by the bank's selection committee based on candidate experience, previous drawn salary, internal salary parity, and post-specific budget allocations.

articles.content_html:
State Bank of India has issued an official notice publishing the CTC Negotiation Format on its official career portal, sbi.co.in. This document serves candidates participating in specialized recruitment drives, contractual appointments, and lateral entry officer positions requiring formal remuneration structuring. Candidates are advised to review the format guidelines carefully to ensure accurate disclosure of current compensation packages and official expectations.

Key Highlights & Important Dates

Event / Activity Official Date / Status
Notification ReleasedSeptember 15, 2026
Official Portalsbi.co.in

Overview & Background of State Bank of India Notification

State Bank of India periodically conducts recruitment drives to fill specialized, executive, and lateral entry positions across its national network. Unlike standard entry-level clerical or probationary officer recruitment, specialist cadre roles and contractual executive positions frequently require detailed evaluations of a candidate's existing remuneration structure before finalizing appointment offers.

On September 15, 2026, the bank released the standardized CTC Negotiation Format to establish a uniform mechanism for document verification and compensation structuring. Candidates who have been shortlisted for personal interviews or final interaction rounds under executive or specialist notifications must complete and submit this form along with verifiable proof of earnings.

Eligibility Criteria & Minimum Educational Qualifications

Eligibility for positions utilizing the CTC negotiation process depends on the specific job notification issued by the bank. Generally, lateral entry and specialist officer roles require candidates to hold minimum academic qualifications from recognized institutions, alongside relevant professional experience.

  • Educational Qualification: Graduation degree, Post-Graduation, MBA, CA, CFA, or B.Tech/B.E. in relevant disciplines from a recognized University or Institute approved by AICTE/UGC.
  • Professional Experience: Candidates must possess the mandatory post-qualification work experience specified in the respective post notification, usually ranging from 2 to 10 years in banking, financial services, or relevant corporate sectors.
  • Documentary Proof: Candidates must present valid proof of employment, service certificates, current pay slips, and Form 16 to validate their current compensation details during evaluation.

Age Limit Criteria & Category-Wise Relaxations

The age criteria for specialized posts are defined individually in each recruitment advertisement, varying by scale and post hierarchy. However, standard relaxation rules established by the Government of India apply to upper age limits for reserved categories.

CategoryStandard Upper Age Relaxation
Other Backward Classes (OBC - Non-Creamy Layer)3 Years
Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe (SC/ST)5 Years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwD)10 to 15 Years (depending on primary category)
Ex-Servicemen (ESM)As per official Central Government norms

Pay Scale, Salary Structure & 7th CPC Allowances

Remuneration for regular Specialist Cadre Officers (SCO) follows the Bipartite Settlement pay scales, while contractual positions are offered on a negotiated market-linked Cost to Company (CTC) basis. The official CTC negotiation format ensures transparency in identifying fixed pay, variable incentives, and perquisites.

For regular officers, compensation includes Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), and superannuation benefits. Contractual appointees receive a consolidated annual package structured around fixed compensation, performance-linked pay, leased accommodation allowances, and medical reimbursement benefits according to bank policy.

Comprehensive Examination Pattern & Syllabus Structure

Depending on the post requirements, the selection process may involve a written/online examination followed by an interview, or direct shortlisting based on qualification and experience prior to the personal interaction.

  • Shortlisting / Screening Test: Online test evaluating Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning Ability, General & Financial Awareness, and English Language fluency.
  • Professional Knowledge Test: Post-specific assessment testing domain expertise, regulatory knowledge, risk management, or technical skills related to the advertised post.
  • Personal Interview: Evaluates domain knowledge, executive competence, suitability for the post, and career progression. Negotiation on compensation package occurs following successful evaluation in this stage.

Step-by-Step Online Application & Document Upload Guide

Candidates requiring the submission of the CTC Negotiation Format must follow the structured steps outlined below to download and complete the document correctly:

  1. Visit the official career portal of State Bank of India at sbi.co.in/careers.
  2. Navigate to the 'Latest Announcements' or 'Recruitment Notices' section on the homepage.
  3. Locate the notification link titled CTC NEGOTIATION FORMAT.
  4. Download the PDF document directly and save it to your local device.
  5. Fill in all required fields accurately, including basic compensation, variable components, perquisites, and proposed expectation figures.
  6. Attach supporting financial documents such as last 3 months' salary slips, latest Form 16, and current appointment/increment letters.
  7. Submit the completed document during the interview or upload it via the candidate portal as instructed by SBI recruitment authorities.

Selection Stages & Final Merit List Formulation

The final merit list for executive and specialized postings is formulated based on candidate performance across evaluation stages and verified documentation. Shortlisted candidates undergo rigorous background checking and credential verification.

For posts where selection is conducted purely via shortlisting and interview, the merit list is prepared strictly in descending order of marks obtained in the interview. If multiple candidates secure equal qualifying marks, rank determination follows standard bank rules based on age or relevant post-qualification experience duration. Offers of appointment remain provisional until medical fitness clearance and successful verification of financial documents submitted via the negotiation form.

Key Preparation Strategy & Exam Day Guidelines

Candidates appearing for document verification and personal interaction should maintain strict compliance with official guidelines to avoid disqualification during administrative scrutiny.

  • Organize all current financial documentation chronologically, ensuring that net and gross income figures match across pay slips, bank statements, and tax filings.
  • Review the specific responsibilities of the advertised position to justify compensation expectations during interaction rounds.
  • Carry original identity cards, educational certificates, experience credentials, and two signed copies of the completed CTC Negotiation Form to the venue.
  • Ensure early arrival at the designated verification center to complete preliminary biometric and document verification procedures smoothly.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Go to the official website of State Bank of India at sbi.co.in.
  2. On the homepage, navigate to the 'Latest Notices' or 'Examination/Recruitment' section.
  3. Locate and select the link for 'CTC NEGOTIATION FORMAT'.
  4. Download and carefully review the official notice for verified instructions.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the official website to verify this State Bank of India update?

The official website is sbi.co.in. Candidates are strictly advised to rely on official links published on sbi.co.in/careers.

Where can I download the official CTC Negotiation Format?

The direct official link is available on the SBI careers page under the announcement section for September 15, 2026.

Is the CTC Negotiation Form required for standard Probationary Officer (PO) roles?

No, standard entry-level PO and Clerical posts follow fixed scale pay structures determined by bipartite settlements and do not require CTC negotiation forms.

What supporting documents must be submitted with the negotiation form?

Candidates must submit recent pay slips, Form 16, latest increment letters, bank statements showing salary credits, and official proof of existing CTC components.

What age relaxations are available for reserved candidates?

OBC candidates receive up to 3 years of relaxation, SC/ST candidates receive 5 years, and PwD candidates receive between 10 and 15 years as per official rules.
